$comment: Proof types are the audited core (circuit or protocol + verifier). New ones are rare and reviewed by the core team; methods only configure them.

proof_types.name: DKIM-signed email
proof_types.description: Proves an email was addressed to an address at a domain and signed by that domain's DKIM key, without revealing the address. Noir circuit + UltraHonk (Barretenberg).

proof_types.name: TLSNotary
proof_types.description: Proves what an HTTPS server sent during a logged-in session (MPC-TLS with a verifier), revealing only selected parts of the response and hash-committing others. Methods that need uniqueness are verified in an attested enclave (Google Confidential Space, Intel TDX).

verifier.name: tlsn verifier server
verifier.path: verifier/ (Cloudflare container) and verifier/gcp/ (Confidential Space enclave)

proof_types.name: OpenCerts / OpenAttestation
proof_types.description: Selective disclosure of an issuer-signed OpenAttestation document (e.g. a Singapore degree certificate): the browser hides every field except the ones a method reveals, and the verifier checks the hashes, the issuer's Merkle root on Ethereum, and revocation. Not zero-knowledge yet: the verifier sees the document's hash and batch.
